title: GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna: October 2026 update
source_says: Sol now powers paid ChatGPT plans and Luna powers Free and Go, replacing GPT-5.6. OpenAI treats both as High cyber capability, below Critical. Self-reported ExploitBench: Sol 82.62%, Luna 44.66%. Health benchmarks also reported.

title: Government response to the National Commission on regulating AI in healthcare
source_says: Published 6 October; not picked up in earlier registers. All 44 recommendations accepted. MHRA draft guidance on changes to AI-enabled devices by December 2026, consultation on qualification and classification in 2027, roadmap by spring 2027. AI Airlock Phase 3 open.

title: Expanding the Cyber Verification Program
source_says: Published 6 October; not picked up in earlier registers. Merges the programme with Project Glasswing into three tiers: Defense, Red Team and Specialized Access. Regional hospitals named as eligible for Defense Access.
